intent: Jumps feel floatier and more natural: a gentler gravity gives a slower rise and fall, and a player who lands keeps some of their sideways momentum and skids on instead of stopping dead.
accept: Rise and fall are visibly slower than before, with a smooth arc
After landing while moving sideways, a player keeps drifting in that direction for a few ticks that fade out
Every platform in the tower is still reachable by a jump (tests pass)
The same inputs always give the same result (determinism test green)

criteria.text: Rise and fall are visibly slower than before, with a smooth arc
criteria.evidence: config.ts gravity 0.7->0.55 but jumpSpeed lowered 11->9.6 and maxFall 16->13, so jump height is nearly unchanged (~84 vs ~86 px peak) and airtime only ~10% longer; after/shot-2 vs before/shot-2 show no discernible difference.

criteria.text: After landing while moving sideways, a player keeps drifting in that direction for a few ticks that fade out
criteria.evidence: rules.ts landing kick (landingCarry 0.6) plus test 'landing while running carries a fading skid'. But total drift is ~2.4*(1/(1-0.6)) ~ 3-6 px, imperceptible.

criteria.text: Every platform in the tower is still reachable by a jump (tests pass)
criteria.evidence: No test asserts reachability against the new jump values; only the diff of constants, peak height barely changed so likely fine but unproven.

criteria.text: The same inputs always give the same result (determinism test green)
criteria.evidence: Existing determinism test unchanged; skid is deterministic arithmetic in rules.ts.

findings: Jump feels the same: in config.ts keep jumpSpeed/jumpHoldBoost/maxFall proportional so gravity change is felt, e.g. gravity 0.4 with jumpSpeed ~8 for a clearly floaty, longer arc, while keeping peak height reachable by platform gaps.
Landing skid is only a few pixels: in config.ts raise landingCarry (and the cap in rules.ts) so the skid slides roughly 30-60 px, noticeable on a phone.
Add a rules.test.ts test that the max jump height (using config values) exceeds the largest vertical platform gap, to prove reachability.

criteria.text: Rise and fall are visibly slower than before, with a smooth arc
criteria.evidence: config.ts gravity 0.7->0.4, jumpSpeed 11->8, maxFall 16->10: peak ~80px vs ~86px, airtime ~40 vs ~31 ticks (about 27% longer, slower rise/fall). Only visible in motion; after/shot-2 shows bots at different heights but no static difference.

criteria.text: After landing while moving sideways, a player keeps drifting in that direction for a few ticks that fade out
criteria.evidence: rules.ts separate skid (landingCarry 1.2, decay 0.85) gives ~30px slide; test 'landing while running carries a fading skid' asserts slide 15-60px and skid returns to 0; standing and jump-cancel tests too.

criteria.text: Every platform in the tower is still reachable by a jump (tests pass)
criteria.evidence: rules.test.ts 'a standing jump clears the largest gap between consecutive platforms' simulates the config jump and compares to sectionHeight/STEPS_PER_SECTION.

criteria.text: The same inputs always give the same result (determinism test green)
criteria.evidence: Existing determinism test kept; skid is pure arithmetic in rules.ts movePlayer.
